items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Finds Novel Cryptographic Attacks on HAWK and Reduced AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview 發現 HAWK 與弱化 AES 新密碼攻擊
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview autonomously discovered an improved key-recovery attack on the post-quantum signature scheme HAWK (halving effective strength) and a Möbius Bridge technique that speeds reduced-round AES attacks by 200-800×. Papers and a new CryptanalysisBench were released; findings have no practical impact on deployed systems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team 報告 Claude Mythos Preview 自主發現對後量子簽章 HAWK 的改進金鑰恢復攻擊（有效強度減半），以及加速弱化 AES 攻擊 200-800 倍的 Möbius Bridge 技術。已釋出論文與 CryptanalysisBench；對現有部署系統無實際影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results demonstrate frontier models can contribute genuine cryptanalytic advances under human guidance, raising both defensive opportunities and questions about future automated discovery of stronger attacks. Anthropic correctly stresses the attacks do not break production HAWK or full AES.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型在人類引導下可貢獻真實密碼分析進展，同時帶來防禦機會與未來自動發現更強攻擊的疑慮。Anthropic 正確強調這些攻擊並未破解生產版 HAWK 或完整 AES。
items_flat.quote: These are substantial research advances, but they don’t have a practical impact on today’s systems. HAWK is a proposed scheme that hasn’t been deployed anywhere, and the AES attack we discovered was on a weaker version and does not break the full cipher.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些是重大研究進展，但對今日系統沒有實際影響。HAWK 是尚未部署的候選方案，我們發現的 AES 攻擊是針對弱化版本，並未破解完整密碼。

items_flat.title_en: 1,100+ AI Lab Staff Petition US to Support Tools for Pacing Frontier Development
items_flat.title_zh: 逾1100名AI大廠員工請願美國支持調控前沿發展工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,100 current and former employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others signed the “Pacing the Frontier” statement asking the US government to support international technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace automated AI research if acceleration becomes excessive. OpenAI and Anthropic officially endorsed the petition; it does not call for an immediate pause.
items_flat.summary_zh: 逾1100名來自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta 等公司的現任與前任員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」聲明，請求美國政府支持可在加速過快時刻意調控自動化AI研究的國際技術與治理工具。OpenAI 與 Anthropic 正式背書；聲明並非要求立即暫停。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cross-lab staff consensus signals growing internal concern about recursive self-improvement risks while stopping short of a moratorium. Whether governments can or will build usable pacing mechanisms remains highly uncertain amid competitive pressures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室員工共識顯示對遞迴自我改進風險的內部關切日益增加，但未訴求全面暫停。在競爭壓力下，政府能否或是否會建立可用的調控機制仍高度不確定。
items_flat.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持國際合作，開發可刻意調控自動化AI發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Quietly Releases Open-Source Codex Security CLI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 悄悄開源 Codex Security CLI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an early open-source release of the Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK. Developers can now scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD pipelines via npm or GitHub.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布早期開源 Codex Security CLI 與 TypeScript SDK。開發者現可透過 npm 或 GitHub 掃描程式庫、跨運行追蹤安全發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入 CI/CD。
items_flat.analysis_en: This makes agentic security scanning more accessible outside ChatGPT Enterprise tiers and could accelerate “security-left” practices in AI-assisted coding. Real-world false-positive rates and coverage on diverse codebases remain to be validated at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓 agentic 安全掃描更易在 ChatGPT Enterprise 以外使用，可能加速 AI 輔助編碼的「安全左移」。真實環境假陽性率與多樣程式庫覆蓋度仍待大規模驗證。
items_flat.quote: We quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI, but Hacker News found it before we had a chance to share it here... You can now use it to scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們悄悄發布了開源 Codex Security CLI，但 Hacker News 比我們更早發現……你現在可以用它掃描倉庫、跨運行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並加入 CI/CD 安全檢查。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Field Report: Agentic AI in Scientific Computing
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 實地報告：Agentic AI 於科學計算
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an exploratory field report of eight case studies (mostly life sciences) showing how Codex and Claude Code agents helped modernize scientific software—from maintenance and optimization to large-scale migrations and redesigns—while emphasizing that researchers must still define questions, verify results, and own long-term stewardship.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布探索性實地報告，涵蓋八個案例（多為生命科學），顯示 Codex 與 Claude Code agents 如何協助現代化科學軟體——從維護、優化到大規模遷移與重設計——同時強調研究人員仍須定義問題、驗證結果並負責長期維護。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report usefully documents real velocity gains but correctly cautions that agents do not remove the need for scientific judgment or sustainable ownership models. Broader adoption will depend on reproducibility standards and institutional incentives.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告有效記錄真實速度提升，但正確提醒 agents 無法取代科學判斷或可持續的所有權模式。更廣泛採用將取決於可重現性標準與機構誘因。
items_flat.quote: While agents can reliably execute on ambitious projects, researchers must still define the scientific questions, verify results, and take a stance on long-term ownership.
items_flat.quote_zh: 雖然 agents 可可靠執行雄心計畫，研究人員仍須定義科學問題、驗證結果，並對長期所有權採取立場。

brief_en: Quiet early Taipei July 30. Carryover from prior evening: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Security CLI for repo scanning and CI/CD; Anthropic’s Mythos Preview found novel attacks on HAWK post-quantum signatures and reduced-round AES (research only, no production impact); 1,100+ staff across labs petitioned for tools to pace frontier AI if needed.
brief_zh: 台北7/30早間動態平靜。前晚重點：OpenAI開源Codex Security CLI供倉庫掃描與CI/CD；Anthropic Mythos Preview發現HAWK後量子簽章與弱化AES新攻擊（僅研究、無生產影響）；逾1100名大廠員工請願支持必要時調控前沿AI發展工具。
